ruleset.name: nitpicker-main-rules
ruleset.description: Nitpicker's PMD rules for main sources.

rule.name: ExhaustiveEnumPredicate
rule.message: These comparisons list only some constants of an enum of the project, so a constant added later silently falls into the other case. Classify every constant: a switch expression without default (adding a constant then fails to compile), or a boolean each constant declares (PAID(true)).

property.name: xpath
property.value: ( //InfixExpression[@Operator = ('||', '&&')][not(parent::InfixExpression/@Operator = @Operator)] [let $root := ., $op := @Operator, $test := if ($op = '||') then '==' else '!=', $statics := /CompilationUnit/ImportDeclaration[@Static = true()], $singles := $statics[not(@ImportOnDemand)]/@ImportedSimpleName, $onDemand := exists($statics[@ImportOnDemand]), $operands := descendant::*[not(self::InfixExpression[@Operator = $op])] [ancestor::*[not(self::InfixExpression[@Operator = $op])][1] is $root/..] [parent::InfixExpression[@Operator = $op]], $constants := $operands/*[pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Enum')] [self::FieldAccess[TypeExpression] or self::VariableAccess[@Name = $singles] or self::VariableAccess[$onDemand][matches(@Name, '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$')]], $subjects := $operands/* except $constants return count($operands) >= 2 and (every $o in $operands satisfies $o[self::InfixExpression[@Operator = $test]] [count(* intersect $constants) = 1] [(* except $constants)[self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess[ThisExpression] or self::MethodCall[ArgumentList/@Size = 0] [*[1][self::ArgumentList or self::VariableAccess or self::ThisExpression or self::FieldAccess[ThisExpression]]] [matches(@MethodName, '^(get|is)[A-Z]') or *[1][not(self::ArgumentList)][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Record')] or (*[1][self::ArgumentList or self::ThisExpression] and @MethodName = ancestor::RecordDeclaration[1]/RecordComponentList/RecordComponent/VariableId/@Name)]]]) and count(distinct-values(for $s in $subjects return if ($s[self::MethodCall]) then string-join(($s/*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess]/@Name, $s/@MethodName), '.') || '()' else string($s/@Name))) = 1 and count(distinct-values($constants/@Name)) = count($constants)] | //MethodCall[@MethodName = 'contains'][ArgumentList/@Size = 1] [*[1][self::MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.EnumSet#of(_*)')]] [ArgumentList/@Size >= 2] [let $statics := /CompilationUnit/ImportDeclaration[@Static = true()], $singles := $statics[not(@ImportOnDemand)]/@ImportedSimpleName, $onDemand := exists($statics[@ImportOnDemand]) return every $c in ArgumentList/* satisfies $c[self::FieldAccess[TypeExpression] or self::VariableAccess[@Name = $singles] or self::VariableAccess[$onDemand][matches(@Name, '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$')]]]] ) [let $self := ., $holder := ancestor::*[not(self::InfixExpression[@Operator = ('&&', '||')] or self::ConditionalExpression or self::UnaryExpression[@Operator = '!'])][1] return $holder[self::ReturnStatement or self::LambdaExpression or self::VariableDeclarator] or $holder[self::AssignmentExpression][not(*[1] intersect $self/ancestor-or-self::*)]]

rule.name: StaticForwardingWrapper
rule.message: This static method only passes its parameters, in order, to another method. Call that method directly where this one is used and delete the wrapper. Factories named of or from and copies such as List.copyOf are allowed.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodDeclaration[pmd-java:modifiers() = 'static'][not(ModifierList/Annotation)][not(TypeParameters)] [not(@Name = ('main', 'valueOf', 'fromString', 'of', 'from'))] [FormalParameters/@Size > 0] [not(ancestor::*[self::ClassDeclaration or self::RecordDeclaration or self::EnumDeclaration]/ModifierList/Annotation [pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Component') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Service') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Repository') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Controller') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ControllerAdvice') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.SpringBootApplication')])] [let $method := ., $parameters := FormalParameters/FormalParameter/VariableId/@Name, $call := Block[count(*) = 1]/(ReturnStatement | ExpressionStatement[$method/VoidType])/MethodCall return exists($call) and not($call/TypeArguments) and not($call/@MethodName = ('copyOf', 'copyOfRange') or starts-with($call/@MethodName, 'unmodifiable') or starts-with($call/@MethodName, 'synchronized') or starts-with($call/@MethodName, 'checked')) and ($call/*[1][self::TypeExpression] or ($call/*[1][self::ArgumentList] and $call/@MethodName != $method/@Name)) and $call/ArgumentList/@Size = count($parameters) and (every $i in 1 to count($parameters) satisfies $call/ArgumentList/*[$i][self::VariableAccess]/@Name = $parameters[$i])]

rule.name: SingularAndPluralMember
rule.message: A member and its plural (tag and tags) are two ways to pass the same data. Keep the plural and pass one item as a one-element list.

property.name: xpath
property.value: ( //RecordDeclaration/RecordComponentList/RecordComponent[not(@Varargs = true())] | //ClassDeclaration[ancestor-or-self::ClassDeclaration/ModifierList/Annotation [pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.context.properties.ConfigurationProperties')]] /ClassBody/FieldDeclaration[not(pmd-java:modifiers() = 'static')] ) [let $boxes := map { 'boolean': 'Boolean', 'byte': 'Byte', 'char': 'Character', 'short': 'Short', 'int': 'Integer', 'long': 'Long', 'float': 'Float', 'double': 'Double' }, $type := (ClassType | ArrayType | PrimitiveType)[1], $element := if ($type[self::ArrayType]) then $type/*[1] else $type[self::ClassType][@SimpleName = ('List', 'Set', 'Collection', 'Iterable', 'SortedSet')] /TypeArguments[count(*) = 1]/*[1], $plural := (VariableId | VariableDeclarator/VariableId)[1]/@Name return exists($element) and (some $other in ../(RecordComponent | FieldDeclaration[not(pmd-java:modifiers() = 'static')]) satisfies let $name := ($other/VariableId | $other/VariableDeclarator/VariableId)[1]/@Name, $own := ($other/ClassType | $other/ArrayType | $other/PrimitiveType)[1], $ownName := if ($own[self::PrimitiveType]) then $boxes($own/@Kind) else $own/@SimpleName, $elementName := if ($element[self::PrimitiveType]) then $boxes($element/@Kind) else $element/@SimpleName return $plural = ($name || 's', $name || 'es', if (matches($name, '[^aeiou]y$')) then substring($name, 1, string-length($name) - 1) || 'ies' else ()) and $own[self::ClassType or self::PrimitiveType] and $ownName = $elementName)]

rule.name: TriStateBoolean
rule.message: A boxed Boolean can be true, false or null, so this has three states that the type does not name. Use an enum that names each state (Mode.ON, Mode.OFF, Mode.AUTO), or a primitive boolean when absence means nothing.

rule.name: ParameterMutation
rule.message: This changes the collection, map or array the caller passed in. Build and return a new one (List.copyOf, a stream, new ArrayList<>(items) filled and returned), or copy the parameter first and change the copy.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $mutators := ('add', 'addAll', 'addFirst', 'addLast', 'remove', 'removeAll', 'removeIf', 'removeFirst', 'removeLast', 'retainAll', 'clear', 'put', 'putAll', 'putIfAbsent', 'merge', 'compute', 'computeIfAbsent', 'computeIfPresent', 'replaceAll', 'sort', 'set', 'push', 'pop', 'poll', 'offer'), $statics := ('sort', 'parallelSort', 'fill', 'setAll', 'shuffle', 'reverse', 'swap', 'rotate', 'replaceAll', 'addAll'), $copies := ('copyOf', 'copyOfRange', 'clone', 'collect', 'toList', 'toArray', 'toSet', 'toMap'), $shared := ('java.util.concurrent.BlockingQueue', 'java.util.concurrent.BlockingDeque', 'java.util.concurrent.TransferQueue', 'java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentMap', 'java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedQueue', 'java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedDeque', 'java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList', 'java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArraySet', 'java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentSkipListSet') return ( //MethodCall[@MethodName = $mutators] /*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess[*[1][self::ThisExpression]]] [pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Collection') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map')] | //MethodCall[*[1][self::TypeExpression/ClassType[@SimpleName = ('Arrays', 'Collections')]]] [@MethodName = $statics]/ArgumentList/*[1][self::VariableAccess] | //AssignmentExpression/*[1][self::ArrayAccess]/*[1][self::VariableAccess] | //AssignmentExpression/*[1][self::ArrayAccess]/*[1][self::ArrayAccess]/*[1][self::VariableAccess] | //AssignmentExpression/*[1][self::ArrayAccess]/*[1][self::ArrayAccess]/*[1][self::ArrayAccess]/*[1][self::VariableAccess] | //UnaryExpression[@Operator = ('++', '--')]/ArrayAccess/*[1][self::VariableAccess] | //UnaryExpression[@Operator = ('++', '--')]/ArrayAccess/*[1][self::ArrayAccess]/*[1][self::VariableAccess] )[let $name := @Name, $at := ., $method := ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::ConstructorDeclaration][1], $params := $method/FormalParameters/FormalParameter/VariableId/@Name return exists($method) and not($method[pmd-java:modifiers() = 'private'] or $method/ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = 'Override']) and not($method/ancestor::*[self::AnonymousClassDeclaration or self::LocalClassStatement or self::ClassDeclaration[pmd-java:modifiers() = 'private']]) and ((self::VariableAccess and $name = $params) or exists($method//VariableDeclarator[VariableId/@Name = $name][*[2][self::VariableAccess[@Name = $params]]]) or exists($method//AssignmentExpression[@Operator = '='] [*[1][self::FieldAccess or self::VariableAccess][@Name = $name]] [*[2][self::VariableAccess[@Name = $params]]])) and not(some $kind in $shared satisfies pmd-java:typeIs($kind)) and not($method//AssignmentExpression[@Operator = '='] [*[1][self::VariableAccess[@Name = $name]]] [*[2][self::ConstructorCall or self::ArrayAllocation or self::MethodCall[@MethodName = $copies]]] [*[2]/descendant-or-self::VariableAccess[@Name = $name]] [@BeginLine < $at/@BeginLine or (@BeginLine = $at/@BeginLine and @BeginColumn < $at/@BeginColumn)])]

rule.name: CompatibilityShim
rule.message: A @Deprecated declaration keeps the old API next to its replacement. Delete it and change its callers to the replacement in the same change.

rule.name: LegacyCalendarApi
rule.message: Calendar.getInstance() and new GregorianCalendar() without a time zone, and new SimpleDateFormat(...) without setTimeZone, read the default time zone and are not thread-safe. Use java.time with an explicit zone: Instant, or ZonedDateTime.now(clock), and a DateTimeFormatter with withZone(zone). Passing a TimeZone to Calendar.getInstance or the GregorianCalendar constructor is allowed.

property.name: xpath
property.value: ( //MethodCall[@MethodName = 'getInstance'][*[1][self::TypeExpression/ClassType[@SimpleName = 'Calendar']]] [not(ArgumentList/*[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.TimeZone')])] | //ConstructorCall[ClassType[@SimpleName = 'GregorianCalendar']] [not(ArgumentList/*[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.TimeZone')])] | //ConstructorCall[ClassType[@SimpleName = 'SimpleDateFormat']] [let $scope := ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::ConstructorDeclaration or self::ClassBody][1], $format := parent::VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name return empty($format) or not($scope//MethodCall[@MethodName = 'setTimeZone']/*[1][self::VariableAccess[@Name = $format]])] )
